title: Leaving Oliver, New York, and the Savoy band battle
summary: He dates leaving Oliver to about 1925; in New York the band battled Chick Webb and Fletcher Henderson at the Savoy but Oliver would not take the money offered, leaving them without a job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: What year was that? Do you remember what year?
I can't remember because I left Oliver in about '25, I think it was. And we went to -- No, we came to New York. That's when I left Oliver.

We played the Savoy Ballroom and we had a battle with Chick Webb and Fletcher Henderson. And they wanted to hire Oliver at the Savoy for about four or five weeks but they didn't want to give him the money that he wanted. So we didn't have a job and we didn't have anything else to do. So then I got -- Luis Russell used to work with us, with me in New Orleans with Paul Barbarin and Willie Santiago and a trumpet player named Arnold Matwire.
